estimates: The model shows the conserved exterior familiar from the 2011 reopening through the September 2024 closure. Scaffolding, temporary works and any changes made in the conservation project are omitted.

The published measured building outline controls the plan. Floor, ridge and window heights, rear extension articulation and iron and plaster ornament are estimates. Interiors, statues and garden structures are outside the scope.

review.notes: Started with the Qualla reference set. Its contemporary hero is share-alike and independent public-domain proof was unavailable for the historic group portraits. For the commonly reproduced early group scene, the bibliographic record establishes publication in 1933. Used NHB written architectural descriptions and a mapped outline, with native elevations.
